Spacing & Radius

Generated from code 4px scale · 8px and 12px radii · container padding

The layout metrics to follow when turning a prototype into platform code: which gaps to use, which radius belongs on what, and how much padding each container already provides.

Base unit

Spacing follows the 4px scale, where 1 is 0.25rem. Every value in a converted screen has to land on that scale — no arbitrary p-[13px].

Spacing between elements

Four steps cover almost everything. gap-4 dominates real usage and is the right default when you are unsure.

gap-1 4px
Inline micro-spacing — icon to label, value to unit
gap-2 8px
Tightly related items — chips, button groups, key/value pairs
gap-4 16px
Default. Between form inputs and sibling layout blocks (default)
gap-6 24px
Separation between sections and content groups

Form layouts

template
<!-- Two-column form. items-start matters: mat-form-field reserves its own subscript space for hints and errors, so rows must top-align. --> <form class="grid grid-cols-2 items-start gap-4">…</form> <!-- Single-column form --> <form class="flex flex-col gap-4">…</form>

Never add bottom margin to a form field

A mat-form-field already reserves subscript space below the input for hints and errors. Adding margin double-spaces the row, and the drift shows up as soon as one field in a row has an error and the others do not.

Corner radius

Two radii carry almost every surface: 8px on controls and cards, 12px on dialogs and page-level containers.

rounded-lg
0.5rem · 8px
Buttons, form fields, cards, dropdowns
rounded-xl
0.75rem · 12px
Dialogs and page containers
rounded
0.25rem · 4px
Small inner elements — scrollbar thumbs, minor accents
rounded-full
9999px · 9999px
Pills, badges, avatars

Buttons pick up 8px because ccaButton reads var(--mat-shape-small) directly. --mat-shape-medium (1.25rem) is declared but has no consumers.

Container padding

Use the existing global classes rather than hand-rolling the padding.

ContainerClass PaddingRadius
Page container.page-containerp-4 (16px), 24px at ≥1920pxrounded-xl
Card / panel—p-4 default, p-6 for spacious surfacesrounded-lg

Dialog body.dialog-container mainp-6, max-height 65vh, min-width 30remrounded-xl (container)
Dialog footer.dialog-container footerp-6, gap-4, centered, top border—

Control heights

A default button and a form field are both 48px tall, so they line up when placed side by side without any alignment work.
